page_title: EIN 5-1 BAY | Eintracht Frankfurt v Bayern Munich 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' A pass from Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by Manuel Neuer and the move breaks down.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes onto the pitch for Fares Chaibi.
89' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Buta and he is replaced by Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt).
88' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
87' Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

86' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Kevin Trapp. Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

85' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.

84' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
81' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Omar Marmoush is replaced by Makoto Hasebe (Eintracht Frankfurt).
81' The referee signals a substitution. Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Ansgar Knauff.
81' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
80' Bayern Munich have a corner.
80' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) sends a cross in and finds Harry Kane inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
78' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Substitution. Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Junior Dina Ebimbe walks off.
74' The attendance is 58000.
74' The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
71' Thomas Tuchel is forced to make a change. Serge Gnabry is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich).
71' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul.
70' Ball possession – 39:61.
67' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
67' The ball goes behind for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
66' Thomas Tuchel has decided to make a change. Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) replaces Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting.
66' It's time for a substitution. Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) comes on in place of Kingsley Coman.

60' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Felix Zwayer to decide. The relieved Eintracht Frankfurt players can finally celebrate. Goal! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a short pass from Omar Marmoush in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 5:1.
60' Eintracht Frankfurt score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
60' A goal, which was scored by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt), was disallowed due to offside.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.
59' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.

55' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
52' Great teamplay by Bayern Munich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

50' 4 - 1 GOAL! Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) runs onto a pass from Fares Chaibi after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 4:1.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Thomas Tuchel probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Noussair Mazraoui. He is replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alphonso Davies is replaced by Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
45+2' Bayern Munich are ruled offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

44' 3 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich). He perfectly collected a pass from Leroy Sane, then unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the top right corner. The score is 3:1.
42' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
39' Bayern Munich earn a corner.

38' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) will take a corner kick.
36' 3 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) was set free in the area by Omar Marmoush and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
34' The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.
31' 2 - 0 Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Manuel Neuer with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:0.
30' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards goal, but Kevin Trapp makes a magnificent save!
29' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will take the free kick.
29' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

25' CHANCE! Leon Goretzka finds Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
23' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) has tested the patience of referee Felix Zwayer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

23' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
21' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

19' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
18' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
15' Neat passing move from Bayern Munich in order to create new attacking opportunities.
12' 1 - 0 Goal! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
12' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the crossbar!
11' Good clearance! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
10' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement.
7' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
7' The Bayern Munich players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' A clumsy foul by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle.
1' That was close. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Felix Zwayer is the one to supervise the game today.
